title: Juicy Brazilian Chicken Brochette
description: Fast, earthy chicken skewers glazed with peach juice and binchotan charcoal flavor, perfect for a quick lunch.
instructions: Thread chicken pieces onto skewers alternating with bay leaves.
Whisk peach juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, lime juice, pepper, paprika, olive oil, and salt until sugar dissolves.
Marinate skewers in the mixture for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Preheat your grill or griddle over medium-high heat and lightly oil the grates.
Place skewers on the grill, turning every 2 minutes, until chicken is cooked through and slightly charred, about 10 minutes.
Baste the skewers with remaining glaze during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes.
Serve hot, optionally with a squeeze of fresh lime and a sprinkle of extra smoked paprika.
